mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through increased liquidity and lower cost of capital.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 9.0% signals severe labor market deterioration that triggers recessionary expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days through risk-off portfolio rebalancing.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 9.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate collapsing consumer demand that reduces corporate revenue visibility, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline from prior month.

mechanism_narrative: Manufacturing supply shock (INDPRO decline > 2% from prior month) reduces corporate output capacity and increases input costs, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days through earnings pressure.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO declines by more than 2% from prior month.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate improving consumer confidence and economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through stronger corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST is rising.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% signals persistent inflation that triggers expectations of aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days through higher discount rates.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL yoy exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in employment (PAYEMS) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal robust economic growth that boosts corporate earnings visibility, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both PAYEMS and RSAFS increase from prior month.

mechanism_narrative: GDP growth below 1.0% annualized signals economic slowdown that reduces corporate earnings growth expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days through risk aversion.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth is below 1.0% annualized.
